# coordinate result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coordinateResult`](gmeow-coordinateResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coordinateResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The [`GeoCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md) result of a coordinate observation — a point expressed as latitude, longitude, and optional elevation. The reference frame in which the coordinates are expressed is carried on the observation via [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) and propagates to the result via the existing [`isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md) ∘ [`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) chain.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) -> [`gmeow:GeoCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)

Use [`gmeow:coordinateResult`](gmeow-coordinateResult.md) from [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) to [`gmeow:GeoCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
